title: PMOS (formerly PCOS) Well-Being Companion — Build-Ready Spec
summary: Build-ready spec for a PMOS/PCOS daily well-being companion: n-of-1 personalization engine, irregular-cycle model, skin-signal vision, nudges, MVP scope.
notes: Manifest-declared SPEC (precedence 3); heuristics agree — implementation contracts (AI stack, model choices, MVP cut, data-handling constraints) dominate. Predates the PRD: where they conflict, PRD wins. Content here likely NOT in the PRD, flagged for synthesizer: (1) the 12 May 2026 PCOS→PMOS Lancet rename hook and PMOS-primary naming rule; (2) specific AI stack choices — interpretable per-user time-series stats over neural nets, Gemini+RAG grounding, closed-source multimodal vision with fixed numeric rubric for hackathon, TFLite on-device as production end state; (3) demo mechanics — seeded 60-day synthetic 'Priya' history and the 90-second demo beat sheet; (4) explicit cut list (community, doctor-share export, wearable import, multi-language depth); (5) competitive table (Flo/Clue, Posiva/Cysterly, Veera Health, Allara); (6) regulatory framing — well-being companion not diagnostic, DPDP Act 2023, SaMD/CDSCO avoidance; (7) named risks — small-n credibility trap, body-image harm, cloud skin-photo privacy gap, escalation duty, churn; (8) GTM — community-led near-zero CAC vs Rs 1,800 CAC, freemium with correlation engine as paid tier; (9) team split and track/role registration answers; (10) sourced evidence stats (anxiety 6x, depression 4x, 84.5% appearance distress, 7-month diagnostic delay).
